claims.evidence: The photo does not show a clearly readable brand/model (the supposed '671' and 'Detriot' are not legible).

risks.risk: Model/engine family may be different from what the seller claims; price depends heavily on exact model and displacement.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the engine nameplate/model plate and serial number (sharp, readable) plus a photo of the full engine ID stamping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used marine engine (worst case vs claimed specific model).

risks.risk: Unknown running condition (may be seized, missing parts, or have internal faults).
risks.proof: Short start video showing cranking and stable idle, plus a clip of water flow/overheat indicator if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case).

risks.risk: Completeness risk: alternator, starter, fuel system parts, cooling components, and wiring harness may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: Photos of both sides of the engine with a checklist: starter, alternator, injection/fuel lines, cooling pump/impeller area, exhaust manifold, and all hoses/connectors.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: buyer may need gearbox/prop shaft/coupler; these may not be included.
risks.proof: Photo showing the gearbox/gearcase connection and what exact transmission/gear unit is included (or not).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming gearbox/gearcase may be missing or not included.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine nameplate/model plate + serial number (sharp enough to read).
Start video (cranking + running) and a brief run under load if possible.
Photos showing completeness: starter, alternator, fuel system/injection components, cooling pump/impeller area, and exhaust manifold.
Photo(s) of the gearbox/gearcase and what is included with the engine.
response.reason: From the single photo, the exact engine brand/model ('Detriot 671') is not readable and running/completeness are not proven, so a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct engine type.
